u8_kalshi_freeze_vs_opener.description: Kalshi game-market spread at the Tuesday pool freeze vs the opener: picking the side the market moved toward, graded at the opener, 2025 only (no 2026 opener archive yet). Regression of opener ATS margin on market-minus-opener: slope 0.94 [0.03,1.91] P+ 0.978 margin pts per pt. Correlates ~0.75-0.78 with the opener-to-close move, so mostly early line movement. One season, not leave-one-season-out; 10 looks in the family.

u8_kalshi_freeze_vs_opener_2026.description: Kalshi market spread at the Tuesday-noon pool freeze vs the Splash locked line, 2026 Weeks 1-4 decisive games, picking the side of the gap. The 2026 gap is small (SD 0.51 vs 1.94 in 2025, whose opener was the early book open), so it is not commensurable with the 2025 cells and is not pooled with them. Leave-one-season-out logistic on the gap did not beat a constant in either fold (slope sign changes). 18 looks in the family.

u8_kalshi_freeze_vs_tuesday_line_pooled.description: Kalshi market spread at the Tuesday-noon pool freeze vs the Tuesday-noon book line (median of 12 books; 2026 uses the Splash locked line), picking the side of the gap, decisive games 2025+2026 Weeks 1-4. Same definition both seasons (gap SD .32-.52). 2025 92-96 -1.06 [-7.98,+5.85]; LOSO log loss beats constant only fit-2025-score-2026 (.6917 v .6932). 26 looks in the family.
